summary.headline: Hansung Cleantech signs KRW 17.8bn supply contract for Pyeongtaek P4 Ph4 ultrapure water plant
summary.what_happened: Hansung Cleantech disclosed a revised single supply contract, with the contract amount changed to KRW 17.77bn from KRW 17.64bn, for the 'Pyeongtaek P4 Ph4 ultrapure water complex facility construction project A' with Samsung E&A Co., Ltd. The contract period runs from Nov 5, 2025 to Dec 31, 2026, and the filing notes the contract amount and period may change as construction progresses.

key_numbers.label: Previous contract amount (as per original disclosure)

summary.why_it_matters: Supply contract disclosures of this type generally report the size and duration of a company's contracted work, which shareholders may use to understand its order backlog and revenue visibility. Amendments to contract amounts are typically disclosed to correct or update previously reported figures.
